problem: The caption reverses the nesting: it says groups sit inside rings and rings inside fields. Every field is a ring and every ring is an abelian group under addition, so the containment runs the other way (abelian groups ⊃ rings ⊃ fields). The caption contradicts both the sketch and its own aria text.
fix: Rings sit inside abelian groups, and fields sit inside rings. Z_6 is an abelian group under addition and a ring under + and ×, while Z_7 climbs to the field layer because 7 is prime.

problem: The sentence is broken and unreadable: 'take a factor d with 1  1, so d has no inverse.' The comparison symbols and middle of the argument are missing, so the proof that a composite modulus fails is lost.
fix: If n is composite, take a factor d with 1 < d < n. Then gcd(d, n) = d > 1, so d has no inverse mod n by the gcd test.

problem: The line writes x⁴ = x⁴ + x + 1 + x + 1 without brackets. Read literally the right side just collapses back to x⁴, so the step does not visibly show the reduction and a student may not see where x + 1 comes from.
fix: In the field, x⁴ + x + 1 ≡ 0, so x⁴ ≡ x⁴ + (x⁴ + x + 1) = x + 1 (mod m(x)), since x⁴ + x⁴ = 0 and 1 + 1 = 0 over GF(2).
